competitions.result: Runners-up — lost 1–0 to Wimbledon at Wembley.
Third round — lost 1–0 at home to Everton.

overview: Liverpool won the First Division under Kenny Dalglish, finishing nine points ahead of Manchester United. They were unbeaten in their first 29 league matches before losing 1–0 at Everton in March, and suffered only two league defeats all season. A 5–0 win over Nottingham Forest at Anfield in April was among their results on the way to the title.

John Barnes arrived from Watford and Peter Beardsley from Newcastle United, while Ian Rush left for Juventus. Ray Houghton joined from Oxford United during the autumn. John Aldridge led the scoring with 29 competitive goals, 26 of them in the league, in his first full Liverpool season.

The FA Cup final prevented another league and cup double: Wimbledon won 1–0 at Wembley, with Aldridge having a penalty saved. Everton had already knocked Liverpool out of the League Cup in the third round. John Wark returned to Ipswich Town and Paul Walsh moved to Tottenham during the season.
